title: Lola Young Announces 2027 Everything Begins Tour
excerpt: Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American headline run set for spring 2027.
body:
Lola Young has announced the Everything Begins Tour, a 17-date North American headline run set for spring 2027. The route includes Radio City Music Hall and the Greek Theatre, with two Toronto nights also on the schedule. It will be her first full tour of the region since she stepped away from touring in 2025.

The title Everything Begins flips one of Young's own tattoos. She has "Everything Ends" tattooed on her body, and the tour name reverses that phrase around the idea of starting again. It gives the announcement a connection to the period she has been writing about in her recent music rather than functioning as a label placed on a list of dates.

Young returned with "From Down Here" after stepping away from touring. She wrote the song with James Blake, and it arrived after "Messy" won a Grammy. The track was her first new music after the break and introduced a more hopeful tone without pretending the difficult period before it had disappeared. Since then, she has moved back into regular live work through festivals and UK shows, gradually rebuilding a schedule that had been interrupted rather than jumping immediately into another long headline run.

[youtube:YFhpMpONGUY]

Everything Begins turns that gradual return into a full headline plan. Young's earlier North American dates used smaller rooms, while the 2027 itinerary moves into venues on a different scale and keeps the same support lineup across the run. The shift is visible in the rooms themselves without needing to turn the story into a list of every city and date on the schedule.

Artist presales begin October 7, followed by the general sale on October 9 at 10 a.m. local time through Young's official site. Sofia and the Antoinettes will support the announced dates. The tour gives Young a continuous headline run at a point when her live career is moving into larger rooms, while the new single provides the clearest indication of what she will be bringing to those stages beyond the songs that first expanded her audience.
